title: RBI Imposes Penalties on Multiple NBFCs for KYC and Governance Violations
description: <cite index="20-4">RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹8.10 lakh on Shri Ram Finance for non-compliance with directions on 'Governance' and KYC</cite>. <cite index="20-8">RBI also imposed ₹2.70 lakh on Progfin Private Limited for non-compliance with KYC Directions</cite>.
